description: Single authoritative record of CI tool versions and the mechanism that verifies each download. Tools are split by acquisition method because the verification story differs: `checksummed_download` tools are fetched by .github/actions/install-checksummed-tool and MUST carry a real SHA-256 (publisher-backed from the release's checksums file; shellcheck publishes none, so its value is the release-asset digest cross-checked locally, see notes and its verification_source); `pinned_action` tools are installed by a first-party action pinned to a full commit SHA, which performs its own checksum and signature verification, so no hash is recorded here.
notes: Schema v1 of this file contained fabricated SHA-256 values: tflint's was 60 characters and contained non-hex letters (a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8...), which could never have matched a real artifact. It also described postgres:16.4-bookworm as a 'pin_digest' when it is a tag.
Rather than invent a replacement hash, tflint now installs via a pinned first-party action that verifies its own download. That is stronger than a hand-copied hash and removes the drift surface.

RESOLVED 2026-09-23 (F-31): all four checksums below were verified against the publishers' own checksums files, fetched from the exact release tag each `url` points at. Three matched. GRYPE DID NOT: this file and .github/workflows/ci.yml both recorded de8f5eb8e2b3bfe65e906945e5a80a5db92aa8c76fc2e7aba3c95a0b4e3b5b89, while anchore publishes 2a087c9ca09969d0e4aa7a14132b5dd2cdb8f050446c1d4b9095044309ee3aec for grype_0.75.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz. Both sites are corrected. Consequence of the wrong value: install-checksummed-tool's `sha256sum -c` failed at the 'Install Grype' step, which failed BOTH container-scan matrix legs before any scanner ran, so all four container-scan[*] signals had no verdict and the aggregate could not go green.

2026-09-30 (F-37): grype bumped 0.75.0 -> 0.119.0. 0.75.0 reads the retired schema-v5 vulnerability DB, which anchore no longer rebuilds; CI run 35971448862 failed with 'db could not be loaded: the vulnerability database was built 28 weeks ago (max allowed age is 5 days)', so grype produced an empty report on every container-scan leg. The new sha256 matches both grype_0.119.0_checksums.txt and the GitHub release-asset digest. tflint's pinned_action version was also corrected v0.59.1 -> v0.64.0 to match what ci.yml actually installs.

2026-10-07 (F-22): shellcheck v0.11.0 added. koalaman/shellcheck publishes NO checksums file, so there is no publisher-signed list to match against. The sha256 is the GitHub release-asset digest for shellcheck-v0.11.0.linux.x86_64.tar.gz (api.github.com/repos/koalaman/shellcheck/releases/latest), and it equals a SHA-256 recomputed locally over the downloaded asset. That is trust-on-first-use through GitHub, weaker than a publisher checksums file, and is recorded as such in verification_source. The archive nests the binary, hence archive_member.

2026-10-07 (F-23): `external_actions` records every third-party action pin (full commit SHA plus the version comment) and test_toolchain_pins.py::TestExternalActionPinSet asserts the workflows and composites use exactly this set, so a Dependabot bump fails CI until this record is updated in the same PR. Every pin was re-verified with `git ls-remote --tags` against its upstream repository on the date above. upload-artifact v7.0.1 and download-artifact v7.0.0 are deliberately one major (v7); download-artifact has no v7.0.1 tag.

HOW TO RE-VERIFY when bumping a version: fetch <release>/…_checksums.txt for the new tag and match the line for the exact archive filename in `url`. Do not copy a hash from anywhere else, and do not set verified:true without doing this — backend/tests/unit/tools/ci/test_toolchain_pins.py fails the build on any entry left unverified.

actionlint.description: GitHub Actions workflow schema and expression validation

gitleaks.description: Secret scanning over full git history

trivy.description: Container image and IaC configuration scanner

shellcheck.verification_source: GitHub release-asset digest (koalaman/shellcheck publishes no checksums file) from https://api.github.com/repos/koalaman/shellcheck/releases/latest, cross-checked against a SHA-256 recomputed locally over the downloaded shellcheck-v0.11.0.linux.x86_64.tar.gz; both equal

tflint.description: Terraform linter. The first-party action verifies the release checksum and GPG signature.

terraform.description: Terraform CLI, static use only (fmt / init -backend=false / validate).

external_actions.verification_method: git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/<repo> refs/tags/<version>; annotated tags compared on the peeled ^{} commit, lightweight tags on the tag line

runner_image.label: ubuntu-24.04
runner_image.description: GitHub-hosted runner image. Must equal pin_authority.runner_image and every runs-on. Preinstalled tools the workflows rely on and do not install: jq and the AWS CLI v2 (the ssm-run composite and the deploy, provision and cognito scripts), gh (release.yml), bash and docker compose (repo-static), git, curl, sudo, tar and unzip. A runner-image bump is a reviewed change to this record.

python.description: Must agree with backend/pyproject.toml requires-python, [tool.ruff] target-version, and backend/Dockerfile.

node.description: Node major. Must agree with backend/tools/ci/pin_authority.py node_runtime_version (major), the .github/actions/setup-frontend node-version default (the exact authority version), frontend/package.json engines.node and the frontend/Dockerfile base tag (node:<node_runtime_version>-bookworm-slim). Asserted by backend/tests/unit/tools/ci/test_toolchain_pins.py.

postgresql.description: CI service container, pinned to a patch-level tag. A digest pin is stronger and remains the target; this is not a digest and must not be described as one.

playwright.description: Must be an exact version in frontend/package.json; the browser revision is derived from the installed package.
